verdict.rationale: Datadog exposes a full REST API, official CLI (datadog-ci), and an MCP server that could be scripted or agent-driven to iterate over many monitors/dashboards/tags, implying bulk operations are technically feasible. However, no evidence explicitly documents batch/bulk endpoints or AI-native bulk-action workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch API endpoints (e.g., bulk mute, bulk tag), MCP server tool descriptions showing multi-item operations, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk automation via AI agents.
